author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000957942

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
human PANK4 (Q9NVE7) and its orthologs
Drosophila CG5828 (Q9VMU2)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous GO term
PANK4 in human and fly acts as a negative regulator coenzyme A biosynthesis (PMID:35896750, PMID:42000723)
Could “negative regulation of coenzyme A biosynthetic process” be used instead?
title: PAINT issue: PTN000957942 coenzyme A biosynthetic process

author: deustp01
body: Yes. PMID: 32234503 "Regulation of coenzyme A levels by degradation: the 'Ins and Outs'" can be added to the list of supporting references.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Newly created terms will not be available for annotation in PAINT for several weeks. The best approach is to make the main annotations yourself first; these will be carried over once they’ve been imported into PAINT. 
I tried to create them using PAINT, but then realized it wasn’t possible yet; while trying to figure out where the problem was coming from, I saw that the term had just been created.
I’ll keep you posted as soon as I can. In the meantime, I removed the annotation “coenzyme A biosynthesis process” for the relevant sections and was able to annotate a portion (including Drosophila, but not humans) using the existing annotation “regulation of the coenzyme A biosynthesis process.”
Could I kindly ask that we reserve the “high priority” label for genuinely urgent matters? With only 1/3 FTE allocated to the entire PAINT project, it makes a significant difference in terms of managing priorities and workload. Thank you very much for your understanding.

author: rozaru
body:
I will avoid the high priority in the future, it’s just that sometimes it is difficult to know when an issue is high priority or not.
The annotation of the human and fly PANK4 with the new GO terms is done. Thanks for removing the IBA annotations.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
No worries at all, it’s absolutely fine. I understand that sometimes it can be difficult to know which priority level is most appropriate, so all good. 😊
We’ll keep the ticket open for now, and I’ll let you know once we can close it.
Thanks a lot, and have a great day.
